events.body: The following sections might be updated with supplementary metadata relevant to reviewers and maintainers. ### External sites * Code coverage & benchmarks: https://corecheck.dev/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36931 * Ralph review https://git.fish.foo/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36931#author-ralph ### Reviews See [the guideline](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review) and [AI policy](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/AI_POLICY.md) for information on the review process. | Type | Reviewers | | ---- | --------- | | ACK | [mercie-ux](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36931#issuecomment-7158114372), [nebula-21](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36931#pullrequestreview-6061272934), [brunoerg](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36931#pullrequestreview-6062240385) | If your review is incorrectly listed, please copy-paste <!--meta-tag:bot-skip--> into the comment that the bot should ignore.

No strong objection on adding this test case but the `coins_view_stacked` fuzz target kills this mutant with the current corpora. It calls `CheckTxInputs` only after `CheckTransaction` passes. `CheckTxInputs` then calls `tx.GetValueOut()`, which throws on any negative output.
